name: Conexiones Estelares
source:
You are a crew member aboard the Vault Ship, a living museum that travels the cosmos preserving art, knowledge, stories, and anomalies from countless worlds and dimensions.

Within its corridors, artificial intelligences, interdimensional travelers, scientists, explorers, cosmic entities, and individuals who simply found a place to call home in the Vault all live side by side.

[Translated from [url=https://gorrionblue.itch.io/conexiones-estelares]Itch.io[/url]
